title: Arithmetic nodal chart data and origin
statement: For a commutative ring $R$ and elements $a,c,\pi\in R$, let $A_{R,a}=R[x,y]/(xy-a)$ [def-trf-strict-semistable-curve], [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. The arithmetic nodal chart data consists of the classes $c,x,y\in A_{R,a}$, the ideal $(x,y)+(\pi)\subset A_{R,a}$, the scheme $M_n=\operatorname{Spec}A_{R,\pi^n}$ and its structure morphism $M_n\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Its centre is the ideal sheaf obtained from $(x,y)+(\pi)$ by the canonical global-sections identification, and a point $o\in M_n$ is the origin when its prime ideal is $(x,y)+(\pi)$.
